dialogues.jp:
呼び鈴の音に部屋を後にし、ゆっくりと階段を
下りる。
dialogues.en: I heard the doorbell ring. I went down the stairs slowly.
dialogues.text: I heard the doorbell ring. I went down the stairs slowly.

dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、めんどくさ……」
dialogues.en: "What a pain...... but I have to do it myself..."
dialogues.text: "What a pain...... but I have to do it myself..."

dialogues.jp:
最近、その手の言葉を使うのを控えていたのだ
が、つい使ってしまった。
dialogues.en: Everything seemed to be so much trouble lately.
dialogues.text: Everything seemed to be so much trouble lately.

dialogues.jp:
音夢の前で、面倒だとかかったるいだとか、冗
談で口になんてできないから。
dialogues.en:
I can't use my favorite words because Nemu will take it
seriously.
dialogues.text:
I can't use my favorite words because Nemu will take it
seriously.

dialogues.jp: 「習慣は恐ろしいってことだな」
dialogues.en: "Yes, yes. Who is it?"
dialogues.text: "Yes, yes. Who is it?"

dialogues.jp: 「はいはい、どちら様です？」
dialogues.en: I opened the door.
dialogues.text: I opened the door.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「私だ」
dialogues.en: "It's me."
dialogues.text: "It's me."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「どうもです先輩！」
dialogues.en: "Hello, sempai!"
dialogues.text: "Hello, sempai!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、美春。白河先生」
dialogues.en: "Miharu, Koyomi-sensei."
dialogues.text: "Miharu, Koyomi-sensei."

dialogues.jp: 久しぶりに見る顔だった。
dialogues.en: I haven't seen them for a while.
dialogues.text: I haven't seen them for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「元気にしてるのか？」
dialogues.en: "How are you?"
dialogues.text: "How are you?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「えぇ……まぁ。それなりに」
dialogues.en: "Yes, fine I guess."
dialogues.text: "Yes, fine I guess."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「では学園に来い……なんて無粋な話はしない
　がね。講師として顔を見に来たというわけさ」
dialogues.en:
"Then you need to come back to school...... Not. I don't
want to sound like I've no delicacy, but I came to check on
you guys as a teacher."
dialogues.text:
"Then you need to come back to school...... Not. I don't
want to sound like I've no delicacy, but I came to check on
you guys as a teacher."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ま、家庭訪問みたいなもんだ」
dialogues.en: "It's like a home visit by a teacher."
dialogues.text: "It's like a home visit by a teacher."

dialogues.jp:
指に挟んだタバコを振って、暦先生がニヤリと
笑う。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei smiled as she held her cigarette between her
fingers.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei smiled as she held her cigarette between her
fingers.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「美春は音夢先輩のお見舞いです」
dialogues.en: "I came to visit Nemu-sempai."
dialogues.text: "I came to visit Nemu-sempai."

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく、どう対応していいものか迷ってし
まう。
dialogues.en: "Oh, I see......"
dialogues.text: "Oh, I see......"

dialogues.jp: 音夢以外の誰かと話すことが久しぶりだったし。
dialogues.en: I didn't know how I should react to them.
dialogues.text: I didn't know how I should react to them.

dialogues.jp:
何より、音夢のことや、俺のことを話しても理
解されないだろう。
dialogues.en:
I suppose they won't understand even if I told them about
Nemu and me.
dialogues.text:
I suppose they won't understand even if I told them about
Nemu and me.

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、元から原因不明の病気ということだった
から、詳しく話す必要もないか……。
dialogues.en:
But, they all knew Nemu had an unknown medical condition to
start out with, so I guess I could make up anything.
dialogues.text:
But, they all knew Nemu had an unknown medical condition to
start out with, so I guess I could make up anything.

dialogues.jp: 「えと、じゃあ上がってください」
dialogues.en: "Um, please come in."
dialogues.text: "Um, please come in."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「へぇ、意外と片付いてるんだな」
dialogues.en: "Well, it's cleaner than I imagined."
dialogues.text: "Well, it's cleaner than I imagined."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「この家にふたりだけですからね。１階はあま
　り、汚れたり散らかったりしません」
dialogues.en:
"There are only two of us. Downstairs doesn't get messy at
all."
dialogues.text:
"There are only two of us. Downstairs doesn't get messy at
all."

dialogues.jp:
緑茶と、適当に作った和菓子を並べてソファー
につく。
dialogues.en:
I sat on the sofa as I placed green tea and some Japanese
sweets I've created on the table.
dialogues.text:
I sat on the sofa as I placed green tea and some Japanese
sweets I've created on the table.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉先輩。音夢先輩の様子はどうなんです
　か？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sempai, how's Nemu-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sempai, how's Nemu-sempai?"

dialogues.jp:
美春が待っていたとばかりに身を乗り出してく
る。
dialogues.en: Miharu sat up and asked me impatiently.
dialogues.text: Miharu sat up and asked me impatiently.

dialogues.jp:
「どうかな……ここ最近は、倒れてばかりだか
　ら」
dialogues.en: "I don't know...... sometimes she collapses suddenly."
dialogues.text: "I don't know...... sometimes she collapses suddenly."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「どのくらいかかりそうなんだ朝倉？」
dialogues.en: "How long do you think it'll take, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "How long do you think it'll take, Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「責めてるんじゃないんだが、このままお前も
　看病で休み続けるのはまずいと思うんだ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not accusing you, but I don't think it's good for you
to keep skipping school to take care of her."
dialogues.text:
"I'm not accusing you, but I don't think it's good for you
to keep skipping school to take care of her."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そうですけど……」
dialogues.en: "I know that......"
dialogues.text: "I know that......"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「このまま一月でも経ってみろ、完全に授業か
　ら置いていかれてしまうぞ」
dialogues.en:
"You won't be able to catch up with the class if you don't
come to school for a month."
dialogues.text:
"You won't be able to catch up with the class if you don't
come to school for a month."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉先輩じゃ、がんばって追いつこうとはし
　ないでしょうしねぇ」
dialogues.en: "You probably won't even try to catch up anyway."
dialogues.text: "You probably won't even try to catch up anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「お前、さり気なくひどいこと言うな」
dialogues.en: "Isn't that too harsh?"
dialogues.text: "Isn't that too harsh?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「かったりぃ〜、とかな」
dialogues.en: "Or as you'd say, what a pain."
dialogues.text: "Or as you'd say, what a pain."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「音夢先輩と朝倉先輩が、このまま美春の同級
　生になるのは嫌です」
dialogues.en:
"I don't want to be in the same graduating class as you and
Nemu-sempai."
dialogues.text:
"I don't want to be in the same graduating class as you and
Nemu-sempai."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「美春」
dialogues.en: "Miharu."
dialogues.text: "Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「だって、どっちと同じクラスになっても、絶
　対に頭上がりませんもん」
dialogues.en:
"It's too much pressure on me to be in the same class with
you guys."
dialogues.text:
"It's too much pressure on me to be in the same class with
you guys."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「お前はなんの心配をしてるんだ」
dialogues.en: "What are you worrying about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you worrying about?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「切実ですって」
dialogues.en: "I'm serious."
dialogues.text: "I'm serious."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……なぁ、灰皿ないか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, do you have an ashtray?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, do you have an ashtray?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「先生、マイペース過ぎます」
dialogues.en: "Sensei, you're so on your own..."
dialogues.text: "Sensei, you're so on your own..."

dialogues.jp:
ふむ、と暦先生がタバコをしまってため息をつ
く。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei sighed and put away her cigarette.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei sighed and put away her cigarette.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、まだどうするかとかは決めてないん
　だな。ま、そんなところだろうから来たんだ
　が」
dialogues.en:
"So, you haven't decided what you want to do about it? I
came to talk about that."
dialogues.text:
"So, you haven't decided what you want to do about it? I
came to talk about that."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん」
dialogues.en: "Well."
dialogues.text: "Well."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「ねぇねぇ、先輩。音夢先輩は寝てるんです
　か？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sempai, is Nemu-sempai sleeping?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sempai, is Nemu-sempai sleeping?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「どうかな。さっき起きたと思ったけど、また
　すぐ寝ちまったし……」
dialogues.en: "I don't know, she was still up a moment ago."
dialogues.text: "I don't know, she was still up a moment ago."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「そう……ですか」
dialogues.en:
"Koyomi-sensei came to talk to you, but I came to talk to
Nemu-sempai."
dialogues.text:
"Koyomi-sensei came to talk to you, but I came to talk to
Nemu-sempai."

dialogues.jp:
やっぱりわんこだな。耳を項垂れて、尻尾がシュ
ンとなっている姿が見えるようだった。
dialogues.en: "Ha ha..."
dialogues.text: "Ha ha..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「寝顔だけでも見れれば落ち着くだろう」
dialogues.en:
"She's in her room upstairs. It may calm you down just to
see her sleep."
dialogues.text:
"She's in her room upstairs. It may calm you down just to
see her sleep."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ラジャーです」
dialogues.en: "Roger that."
dialogues.text: "Roger that."

dialogues.jp:
本当に、飼い主にじゃれつこうとする子犬のよ
うに美春が部屋を飛び出していく。
dialogues.en: Miharu ran out of the room like a puppy.
dialogues.text: Miharu ran out of the room like a puppy.

dialogues.jp:
「あぁ、あれくらいの性格だと、人生がかった
　るくなんて感じんだろうな」
dialogues.en:
"I guess she would never feel life sucks with that
character."
dialogues.text:
"I guess she would never feel life sucks with that
character."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「なぁ、朝倉。正直なところどうなんだ？」
dialogues.en: "So, Asakura. What's really going on?"
dialogues.text: "So, Asakura. What's really going on?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「？　なにがです？」
dialogues.en: "What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いくら音夢の調子が悪いからって、よほどの
　ことじゃない限り、お前だって顔くらい見せ
　るだろう」
dialogues.en:
"I know Nemu isn't feeling well, but I'm sure you'd come to
school if it wasn't too bad."
dialogues.text:
"I know Nemu isn't feeling well, but I'm sure you'd come to
school if it wasn't too bad."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そんなに悪いのか？」
dialogues.en: "Is she that bad?"
dialogues.text: "Is she that bad?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「まぁまぁ、です」
dialogues.en: "Well, so-so."
dialogues.text: "Well, so-so."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「素直じゃないな、お前は。頼れよな。これで
　もお前達より２歳くらい年はとってるんだ」
dialogues.en:
"You're not being honest, man. You should trust me. I'm
about two years older than you guys."
dialogues.text:
"You're not being honest, man. You should trust me. I'm
about two years older than you guys."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「先生……２歳ってのは無理があります」
dialogues.en: "Koyomi-sensei...... you can't pass with just two years."
dialogues.text: "Koyomi-sensei...... you can't pass with just two years."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いいんだよ。精神的には」
dialogues.en: "It's fine. I'm talking about mentally."
dialogues.text: "It's fine. I'm talking about mentally."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「つまり、その頃からまったく成長して――
　って！」
dialogues.en:
"So, you're saying that you haven't grown up mentally since
then...... Ouch!"
dialogues.text:
"So, you're saying that you haven't grown up mentally since
then...... Ouch!"

dialogues.jp: がす、と足を蹴られた。
dialogues.en: She kicked my leg.
dialogues.text: She kicked my leg.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ところで灰皿は？」
dialogues.en: "So, where's my ashtray?"
dialogues.text: "So, where's my ashtray?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……はいはい」
冗談めかして笑いながらソファーを立つ。
dialogues.en: I joked a little and stood up.
dialogues.text: I joked a little and stood up.

dialogues.jp:
台所から、昔親父が使っていた灰皿を引っ張り
だしてきた。
dialogues.en: I found an old ashtray my dad used to use in the kitchen.
dialogues.text: I found an old ashtray my dad used to use in the kitchen.

dialogues.jp: 「どうぞ」
dialogues.en: "Here you go."
dialogues.text: "Here you go."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ありがと……随分と腰が軽くなったもんだな」
dialogues.en:
"Thanks. I'm amazed by your agility. You weren't that fast
before."
dialogues.text:
"Thanks. I'm amazed by your agility. You weren't that fast
before."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、正確には表情というか何というか」
dialogues.en: "How about the agility at night?"
dialogues.text: "How about the agility at night?"

dialogues.jp: そう言って、先生が小さく笑った。
dialogues.en: "Cough----!"
dialogues.text: "Cough----!"

dialogues.jp: 「でも、どうして俺と音夢のことが……」
dialogues.en: I coughed in surprise.
dialogues.text: I coughed in surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ことりに聞いたんだよ」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha..."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha..."

dialogues.jp:
ことりと美春の前でキスしたことを思い出して、
顔が熱くなる。
dialogues.en: "That's sexual harassment......"
dialogues.text: "That's sexual harassment......"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ことり、お前と同じクラスだって喜んでたぞ」
dialogues.en: "So your sister turned into your girlfriend?"
dialogues.text: "So your sister turned into your girlfriend?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そうなんですか……へぇ、今年はことりと同
　じクラスだったのか」
dialogues.en:
"I heard it from Kotori too. She was happy to be in the same
class with you."
dialogues.text:
"I heard it from Kotori too. She was happy to be in the same
class with you."

dialogues.jp:
入学式に出ていないので、クラスも知らなかっ
たな、そういえば。
dialogues.en:
"Really...... I'm in the same class with Kotori this
year..."
dialogues.text:
"Really...... I'm in the same class with Kotori this
year..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「それで、本当にどうする気なんだ」
dialogues.en:
I didn't go to the entrance ceremony at all, so I didn't
know which class I was in.
dialogues.text:
I didn't go to the entrance ceremony at all, so I didn't
know which class I was in.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そうですね……」
dialogues.en: "This is bad. So, what are you going to do?"
dialogues.text: "This is bad. So, what are you going to do?"

dialogues.jp:
今なら、胸のモヤモヤを、少しは形にできるか
も知れない。
dialogues.en: "Well...... please don't be mad."
dialogues.text: "Well...... please don't be mad."

dialogues.jp: 「……あの、怒らないでくださいね」
dialogues.en: I put my fingers together and looked at the ceiling.
dialogues.text: I put my fingers together and looked at the ceiling.

dialogues.jp: 指を合わせて、天井を見上げる。
dialogues.en: "I think it's okay to do this year again."
dialogues.text: "I think it's okay to do this year again."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「このまま１年経ってでも――音夢と一緒に入
　学して、一緒に卒業していきたいんです」
dialogues.en:
"I don't mind wasting this year, I still want to start and
graduate with her."
dialogues.text:
"I don't mind wasting this year, I still want to start and
graduate with her."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「逃げじゃなくて、俺はあいつを守るって決め
　たから」
dialogues.en: "I decided not to run away, but protect her."
dialogues.text: "I decided not to run away, but protect her."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ずっと一緒にいるって、側にいるって、そう
　決めたから」

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "It's making me embarrassed to listen to you."
dialogues.text: "It's making me embarrassed to listen to you."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「聞いてて恥ずかしいな」
dialogues.en: "Be serious, man."
dialogues.text: "Be serious, man."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……言ってる方も恥ずかしいですよ」
dialogues.en:
"I see. I won't say anything about you skipping school for a
while. I'll help you with study when you decide to come
back."
dialogues.text:
"I see. I won't say anything about you skipping school for a
while. I'll help you with study when you decide to come
back."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「仕方ない。もう少しだけお前の休学には目を
　つぶろう。復学できたら勉強も手伝うよ」
dialogues.en: "Oh."
dialogues.text: "Oh."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "I'm leaving Miharu here."
dialogues.text: "I'm leaving Miharu here."

dialogues.jp:
タバコを灰皿に押し付けて、暦先生が立ち上が
る。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei stood up as she put out her cigarette on the
ashtray.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei stood up as she put out her cigarette on the
ashtray.

dialogues.jp: 「……音夢に会っていかないんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Aren't you going to see Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Aren't you going to see Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「特に言うこともないからな。それに天枷と違っ
　て、あたしを見れば嫌でも学園のことを思い
　出す」
dialogues.en:
"I don't have anything to say. And she'll remember about
school if she saw me, unlike Miharu."
dialogues.text:
"I don't have anything to say. And she'll remember about
school if she saw me, unlike Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Thank you......"
dialogues.text: "Thank you......"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「似合わないから止めろ」
dialogues.en: "Stop that, it's so unlike you."
dialogues.text: "Stop that, it's so unlike you."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「それ、杉並にも言われました」
dialogues.en: "Suginami said that to me, too."
dialogues.text: "Suginami said that to me, too."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あれと一緒にするな」
dialogues.en: "Don't mention that."
dialogues.text: "Don't mention that."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あ、そう言えば、眞子と杉並と、さくらはど
　のクラスになりました？」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, how about Mako, Suginami and Sakura? What class are
they in?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh, how about Mako, Suginami and Sakura? What class are
they in?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「水越は別だ。杉並は腐れ縁だな。芳乃は……」
dialogues.en:
"Mizukoshi's in a different class, you can't get rid of
Suginami even if you tried, and Yoshino......"
dialogues.text:
"Mizukoshi's in a different class, you can't get rid of
Suginami even if you tried, and Yoshino......"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「どうしました？」
dialogues.en: "What happened?"
dialogues.text: "What happened?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「退学届を出している」
dialogues.en: "She quit school."
dialogues.text: "She quit school."

dialogues.jp:
音夢のことを考えたり、感じたりした時とは違
う感覚が、胸に走った。
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉音夢の休学が決定した日に、芳乃も退学
　届を出したんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"The day school decided to forbid Nemu from returning,
Yoshino came with a notice of withdrawal."
dialogues.text:
"The day school decided to forbid Nemu from returning,
Yoshino came with a notice of withdrawal."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "What's she doing?"
dialogues.text: "What's she doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、あたしはこれで帰る。この時期は忙
　しくてね」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, I have to go now. I'm pretty busy this time of the
year."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, I have to go now. I'm pretty busy this time of the
year."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「え……あ、はい」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生を見送った後、俺はソファーに座りなが
ら、小さくため息をついた。
dialogues.en:
After Koyomi-sensei left, I sat on the sofa and sighed a
little.
dialogues.text:
After Koyomi-sensei left, I sat on the sofa and sighed a
little.

dialogues.jp: ２階から、美春の元気な声だけが聞こえていた。
dialogues.en: I heard the happy voice of Miharu coming from upstairs.
dialogues.text: I heard the happy voice of Miharu coming from upstairs.

dialogues.jp:
そして、いくら耳を澄ましても音夢の声は届か
なかった。
dialogues.en: But I couldn't hear Nemu's voice even if I tried hard.
dialogues.text: But I couldn't hear Nemu's voice even if I tried hard.

dialogues.jp: ◆暦のお見舞い◆
dialogues.en: ◆Visit from Koyomi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Visit from Koyomi◆

dialogues.jp: 夜になって、暦先生と美春が家を訪ねてきた。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei and Miharu came to visit at night.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei and Miharu came to visit at night.

dialogues.jp:
美春は音夢のお見舞いだが、暦先生は、俺が学
園に出てこないことも心配してくれているよう
だ。
dialogues.en:
Miharu came to see Nemu, but Koyomi-sensei was worried about
me not going back to school.
dialogues.text:
Miharu came to see Nemu, but Koyomi-sensei was worried about
me not going back to school.

dialogues.jp:
そんな風に、心配をしてくれる人間がいること
が嬉しいと思えた日だった。
dialogues.en:
I felt happy to realize there are people out there who worry
about us.
dialogues.text:
I felt happy to realize there are people out there who worry
about us.
